history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). He is wearing a black hoodie with the hood up, and a simple silver chain with a pendant around his neck. The overall mood is one of quiet intensity, mystery, and urban cool.
